messages:
Asha (GTM): quick follow-up from this morning's all-hands re: partner GTM asks. I'll drop bullets, pls respond inline.
Maya (Sales): ready. short answers preferred.
Asha (GTM): 1) leadership asked: should we offer partner credits (pilot credits) or reserved Dedicated credits for pilot partners? pros/cons?
Priya (CEO): credits should be tied to measurable milestones. prefer pilot credits for discovery, Dedicated commitments only when partner shows ramp.
Diego (Partnerships): agreement. pilots -> credits; Dedicated reserved asks need a 3-month usage forecast + legal review.
Maya (Sales): pilots convert faster when partner gets co-marketing support and a sandbox with realistic latency.
Asha (GTM): 2) partner portal / marketplace listing timeline? can we do a soft-listing this quarter?
Nina (Product): we can enable a basic partner"listing" toggle in the partner admin in 2 sprints. marketplace integration (billing + SKU) is a 4-sprint project.
Jules (RevOps): marketplace listing needs a SKU and price band to show. recommend soft-listing without billing first.
Asha (GTM): 3) attribution & reporting: ops needs partner tag in exported usage logs for weekly revenue ops digest.
Nina (Product): we already emit X-Partner-Id header at runtime; persisting to the usage export is a small ETL change. estimate: 1 sprint eng + 1 sprint analytics.
Jules (RevOps): once persisted, I can wire it into a weekly "partner influence" card. Please include partner display name mapping.
Diego (Partnerships): add that we need partner tier (A/B/C) in export too. helps prioritization.
Asha (GTM): 4) routing rules: sample CRM rule needed so SDR/AE handoff is consistent. can someone draft?
Jules (RevOps): draft CRM rule (will drop into drive):
```
if referral_score >= 8 and est_arr >= 50k then assign_to = "AE"
else assign_to = "SDR"
```
Diego (Partnerships): add calendar-check fallback: if AE unavailable -> assign to primary SDR.
Maya (Sales): good. also include SLA: AE first-touch <= 48h for partner referrals.
Asha (GTM): 5) partner pilot readiness slide for execs. what are the must-haves?
Sam (Legal): must-have: data handling summary, subprocessors list, pilot data retention policy, and SOC2 checklist status. label tickets as pilot-fasttrack.
Maya (Sales): also include integration readiness, sample POC plan, go/no-go criteria, and expected conversion % to pay.
Diego (Partnerships): I'll assemble a 1-slide template and share in #partners.
Asha (GTM): 6) are there any blockers for the EU pilot next week?
Diego (Partnerships): legal sign-off pending on the DPA addendum and SOC2 confirmation. ops-bot: reminder created for Legal review in 48h.
Sam (Legal): on it. please add partner contact + data flow diagram to PR-4982.
Diego (Partnerships): uploaded the diagram and contacts: https://redwood.internal/PR-4982
Asha (GTM): action items: Diego -> pilot slide + partner details (due Wed EOD). Jules -> CRM rule + dashboard card (due Thu). Nina -> schedule export change (confirm sprint). Sam -> DPA & SOC2 check (48h). Maya -> update sales playbook with SLA.
Jules (RevOps): calendar invites for a 30m sync sent. will include a dashboard mock.
ops-bot: Weekly partner health report scheduled -> #partners every Monday 9:00am PT.
Asha (GTM): thanks all. I'll stitch this into a 1-slide Exec summary and ping Priya.
Priya (CEO): great — keep it tight.
Maya (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup:
